items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I think Roy Palmer was another good tromboneist.

ctx.x: No. Did you ever hear Kid Ory when you were younger? He left town I think pretty early before
you got here. Before I got here he was gone. He was gone. Yeah. I think Roy Palmer was another good
tromboneist. He left though wait before your time. I knew him in Chicago. I heard his records. I can't think of anybody else now to ask about the tromboneist that you might have heard.
